method: requirements-check-1 (Sonnet 5 judge + Sonnet 5 check; disagreements unknown; quotes verified)

apiKey.keyFor: A free Causal Map account (sign in or sign up in the browser and approve the pairing) is needed to create and code the map

evidence.quote: A Causal Map tab opens in your browser. Sign in or sign up, then click **Approve**.
It talks to the hosted service at app.causalmap.app (and the Causal Map database). There is nothing to install or run locally.

checkNote: Both quotes are in the pack. 'Sign in or sign up, then click Approve' shows an account on a third-party service is needed, and that counts. The hosted service plus 'nothing to install or run locally' and the only code host being the Causal Map server show no local model.
